name: Cupriferous-Crucible
description: A shell of ancient ice seals the world, cracked into plates the size of nations and refrozen in place. Pressure ridges stack in turquoise ramparts, gleaming under a stingy sun near a nearby asteroid belt.
With no air to speak of, silence is total, broken only by whatever touches your boots. The horizon stays razor-sharp at any distance.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
